formatted_question:
According to the opinion 'Pacito v. Trump', the majority’s funding discussion implies that § 1522 services were not blocked for lack of appropriations because
(A) only State Department funds remained
(B) additional congressional authorization was required
(C) appropriations remained available
(D) no ORR-specific funds existed
(E) the rescission exhausted the appropriation
distractors: ["the rescission exhausted the appropriation", "no ORR-specific funds existed", "only State Department funds remained", "additional congressional authorization was required"]
fact: According to the opinion 'Pacito v. Trump', the majority’s funding discussion implies that § 1522 services were not blocked for lack of appropriations because appropriations remained available
